feed.title: Xenolith: exploited flaws in shared components
feed.subtitle: Flaws in widely embedded components and vendor engines with the newest sign of exploitation.

entry.title: Check Point SmartConsole Improper Authentication
entry.summary: Exploited in the wild: CVE-2026-16232 in Check Point Gaia (Security Gateway and Management). In CISA KEV since 2026-07-22. EPSS 80.11%. Products named: Check Point Quantum Security Management. 2 products have a vendor statement, 0 with no fix stated.

entry.title: vCenter 2026 exploited flaws
entry.summary: Exploited in the wild: CVE-2026-123890, CVE-2026-59310, CVE-2024-37079 in VMware vCenter. In CISA KEV since 2026-01-23 and used in ransomware attacks. EPSS 88.46%. Three flaws reachable by anyone with network access to vCenter, each 9.8 and in CISA KEV. CVE-2026-123890: authentication bypass in the VMware Directory Service (VMSA-2026-0009), used as a zero-day since early September 2026 according to Mandiant; in KEV since 2026-11-20, a day after publication. Products named: VMware vCenter Server. 5 products have a vendor statement, 0 with no fix stated.

entry.title: Axis 1.x SOAP fault class instantiation RCE
entry.summary: Exploited in the wild: CVE-2026-90436 in Apache Axis 1.x (SOAP engine). In CISA KEV since 2026-11-18. EPSS 2.70%. Unauthenticated remote class instantiation through a crafted SOAP fault. Axis 1.x is end of life with no upstream fix; CISA added it to KEV on 18 November 2026. Products named: Atlassian Confluence Data Center, N-able N-central. 3 products have a vendor statement, 1 with no fix stated.

entry.title: Java4Shell (HotSpot AVX-512 Base64 decoder heap overflow)
entry.summary: Working exploit, no login needed: CVE-2026-114938 in OpenJDK / HotSpot Java runtime (JDK, JRE). EPSS 59.27%. Only on x86-64 CPUs with AVX-512 VBMI (Intel Ice Lake and later Xeons and some Core chips, AMD Zen 4 and later); ARM64 is not affected. Also affected: Oracle Java SE 8 Enterprise Performance Pack 8u511b33-perf (fixed in 8u513-perf) and GraalVM Enterprise Edition 21.3.20.0.3. Products named: Atlassian Confluence Data Center, Atlassian Jira Data Center, JFrog Artifactory, Jenkins Project Jenkins, Keycloak, Ping Identity PingFederate and 5 more. 536 products have a vendor statement, 100 with no fix stated.

entry.title: BIG-IP APM OAuth heap overflow
entry.summary: Exploited in the wild: CVE-2026-94127 in F5 Traffic Management Microkernel (TMM). In CISA KEV since 2026-09-22. EPSS 1.29%. Heap overflow (CWE-122, 9.8) that runs code with no login when BIG-IP APM acts as an OAuth Authorization Server on a virtual server; APM used only as an OAuth client or resource server is not exposed. Products named: F5 BIG-IP APM. 4 products have a vendor statement, 0 with no fix stated.
